name: fleet-street
description: Banner above the prompt: limits, context, prompt-cache countdown, session timer, git branch, worktrees, subagents with their models, background tasks, open PRs with their checks, workflow runs, the current milestone, and the branch's diff

awayMinutes.title: Away check (minutes)
awayMinutes.description: Minutes without activity before the banner asks whether to keep the session timer going

mainBranch.title: Expected branch
mainBranch.description: The branch shown in green; any other branch is shown in yellow as a warning

showWork.title: Show PRs and diff
showWork.description: Show the row of open PRs (with their checks) and the diff beside the branch, against the expected branch

showSessions.title: Show recent sessions
showSessions.description: Show the row of recent sessions from every project; /toggle-sessions hides or shows it for the current session

contextWarnTokens.title: Context warning (tokens)
contextWarnTokens.description: Context size at which ctx turns yellow, whatever its percentage

contextHandoverTokens.title: Context handover (tokens)
contextHandoverTokens.description: Context size at which ctx turns red, the point to hand over to a new session

milestone.title: Milestone
milestone.description: The milestone the ms row follows, by its title; empty picks the open one with the lowest version
